_meta.title: v11: plug-and-play CNN-DDQN modules (Dueling + CBAM + NoisyNet + MHA + QR-DQN)
_meta.summary: Add 5 plug-and-play modules on top of v9p2. Each independently toggled via CLI flags.

new_flags.--dueling: Dueling DQN (Wang et al., 2016): split Q into V(s) + A(s,a)
new_flags.--cbam: CBAM attention on CNN feature maps (Woo et al., ECCV 2018)
new_flags.--noisy-net: NoisyNet exploration via parameter noise (Fortunato et al., ICLR 2018)
new_flags.--mha: Spatial multi-head self-attention on CNN feature maps
new_flags.--n-quantiles N: QR-DQN quantile regression (Dabney et al., AAAI 2018; 1=standard DQN)

commands.smoke_dueling: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --dueling --out v11-dueling
commands.smoke_cbam: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --cbam --out v11-cbam
commands.smoke_noisy: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --noisy-net --out v11-noisy
commands.smoke_mha: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --mha --out v11-mha
commands.smoke_qr32: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --n-quantiles 32 --out v11-qr32
commands.smoke_all: conda run -n ros2py310 python -m forest_vehicle_dqn.cli.train --profile v9p2 --episodes 150 --dueling --cbam --noisy-net --mha --n-quantiles 32 --out v11-all
